cardOverview.overviewText: The MakeMyTrip ICICI Bank Credit Card is a co‑branded travel card that earns up to 6% myCash on hotel bookings and strong rewards on flights & other spends via MakeMyTrip, plus lounge access and travel perks.

mileStoneItems.benefits: The renewal fee will be waived and get MakeMyTrip hotel voucher (valid for 3 months) worth ₹1000.
